LanguageData.WorldTileScouting.label: world tile scouting
LanguageData.WorldTileScouting.description: Develop remote observation protocols that combine long-range sensor work with faction doctrine analysis. Once researched, you can order a scout of an enemy settlement, work site, or inhabited camp on the world map. After one day of processing, you receive an expected force summary — combat mix, armor tags, and weapon categories — without revealing living pawns on an ungenerated map.
